_doc: Per-faction ship texture atlas: 4x4 cells of 512 px (2048 px), 8 px wrap gutter inside every cell. Array index = cell index (row-major). Read by scripts/ship-textures.mjs (prompts, processing) and src/ships/build (cell lookup, metres per tile). tile: seamless texture repeated in the shader; size: metres covered by one repeat. sheet: several flags packed in one cell (cols x rows).
style: Flat orthographic front/top-down view filling the whole square image edge to edge, even soft diffuse lighting, no baked shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no border, no frame, no watermark, game asset albedo texture, photoreal painterly detail.
